items.message: Regex used to discover workflow IDs and function names is applied to source code read via `inspect.getsource`, then the extracted function name is passed to `getattr` on the module.
`show-workflow --registered` calls `_default_lockstep()` to load the lifecycle module before listing registered workflows; the security properties of that load path are not visible in this diff.
